title: Portfolio-aware scenario transfer of reserve movements: evidence from Lloyd's syndicates
abstract: arXiv:2611.08968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A claims-development movement on one portfolio may not transfer directly as a stress to another size. We estimate how to transfer such scenarios between portfolio sizes, using 632 syndicate-years from 117 Lloyd's syndicates over 2015-2024. The measured movement is the change in gross claims estimates on selected older underwriting cohorts, divided by opening gross claims outstanding plus reserves taken on in the year whose development it includes; it is not a pure measure of opening-reserve deterioration. Its dispersion falls materially with reserve size, and a size-based scale predicts held-out syndicates far better than a single market scale. But the transferred upper tail understates the smallest books: in the smallest reserve-size quartile, six of 158 held-out observations exceeded the transferred 99.5th percentile, against 0.79 expected, from three syndicates. Square-root scaling has descriptively lower held-out pinball loss at 99%

translated_title: 基于组合规模的准备金变动情景转移：来自劳合社辛迪加的证据
translated_abstract: 一个组合上的赔款发展变动未必能直接作为压力情景转移到另一规模的组合上。我们利用2015–2024年间117家劳合社辛迪加的632个辛迪加-年度数据，估计如何在不同组合规模之间转移此类情景。所测量的变动是选定较老承保年度组合的毛赔款估计值的变化，除以期初毛未决赔款加上当年吸收的、其发展包含于该变动中的准备金；它并非对期初准备金恶化的纯粹度量。该变动的离散度随准备金规模增大而显著下降，且基于规模的量表对留出样本辛迪加的预测效果远优于单一市场量表。但转移后的上尾低估了最小的账簿：在最小准备金规模四分位组中，158个留出观测值中有6个超过转移后的99.5百分位数，而预期仅为0.79个，且这6个观测来自三家辛迪加。平方根标度在99%分位的留出样本pinball损失上描述性地更低。
tldr: 该论文基于劳合社辛迪加十年数据提出了随组合规模变化的准备金变动压力情景转移方法，发现规模量表对样本外辛迪加的预测显著优于单一市场量表，但转移后的上尾会低估最小组合的极端风险，而平方根标度在99%分位上表现更好。
en_tdlr: Using a decade of Lloyd's syndicate data, this paper proposes portfolio-size-aware scaling for transferring reserve-development stress scenarios, showing that size-based scales predict held-out syndicates far better than a single market scale, yet the transferred upper tail understates the smallest portfolios, for which square-root scaling yields descriptively better 99% pinball loss.
